title: Kairos: Grounded Forecasting of Presence and Directional Flow in 4D Scene Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2609.27467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-term autonomy in human-populated environments requires anticipating whether and how people will move at times a robot has not yet observed. Existing representations of pedestrian motion face a tradeoff: they either forecast future activity, reducing each location to a scalar rate, or model the full directional distribution, holding it fixed in time. We present Kairos, a predictive directional-flow memory that extends a hierarchical 3D scene graph (3DSG) to a 4D scene graph (4DSG). Every observed voxel of the reconstructed geometry stores a directional mixture and a presence rate, and spectral predictors forecast, for any future query time, both the probability that people are present and the full directional distribution of their motion. translated_title: Kairos：基于4D场景图的存在性与方向性流动的有据预测
translated_abstract: 在有人类活动的环境中实现长期自主运行，需要机器人能够预判在尚未观测到的未来时刻，人们是否移动以及将如何移动。现有的行人运动表征面临权衡：要么预测未来活动，但将每个位置简化为一个标量速率；要么对完整的方向分布建模，但使其在时间上固定不变。我们提出了Kairos，一种预测性方向流记忆，将层次化的3D场景图（3DSG）扩展为4D场景图（4DSG）。重建几何中的每个被观测体素都存储一个方向混合分布和存在率，谱预测器可以针对任意未来查询时刻，同时预测人员存在的概率及其运动的完整方向分布。相邻体素之间的成对流动依赖关系支持条件查询，且每个体素的预测方差可产生经校准的置信区间，该区间随观测数据的积累而不断收窄。我们……
tldr: Kairos将层次化3D场景图扩展为4D场景图，通过预测性方向流记忆，可对任意未来时刻的人员存在概率及其运动的完整方向分布进行预测，并给出随观测积累而收窄的校准置信区间。
en_tdlr: Kairos extends hierarchical 3D scene graphs into 4D scene graphs via a predictive directional-flow memory that forecasts, for any future query time, both the probability of human presence and the full directional distribution of their motion, with calibrated credible intervals that tighten as observations accumulate.
